reviews.body:
Being part of the AIS+ community has genuinely been a great experience. I’ve met some wonderful people, and one of the things I appreciate most is how supportive everyone is. People are willing to share what they know, answer questions, and help each other rather than making it feel like everyone is competing with one another.

Nate and his team also provide some amazing resources, and you can tell they put a lot of effort into giving the community tools and information that are actually useful.

I am a life-long learner. I've sat through webinars, watched countless videos, listened to blogs, and attended summits. Every time I come away with ideas and the overwhelming desire to act. But they all have one thing in common, not one of them has showed me HOW.

AIS+ is different. I have endless resources in this community that not only explain workflows and tools , but show you how to use them. They teach you, build with you, encourage and supports you. Do it, you won't regret it.

reviews.body: I am a July member of AIS+ and part of the AIS free skool for about 8 months.  My experience has been overwhelmingly positive.  My key takeaways: the content is very well done and in a space that is changing as rapidly as AI the content that Nate & team have put in place has held up remarkably well.  The members in both communities are the most supportive and collaborative I have seen anywhere on line - zero haters.  Can't think of another platform/community demonstrating that.

metadata.bio: Ex-Exec, Engineer, Builder, Going back to my roots.

reviews.body: Both the AIS and AIS+ communities are amazing when it comes to learning and building your AI skillset. Nate's teaching is easily understandable yet simultaneously very impactful. Other content producers in this space are sometimes hard to follow, like watching a squirrel on speed, and they leave you confused and feeling like you're falling behind. Nate is calm, collected, and organized. A true professional and a phenomenal teacher. Highly recommend diving into his communities!

metadata.bio: Just a massive nerd living his best life

reviews.body: AIS+ has fundamentally changed how I approach AI. Instead of chasing tools, I’ve learned to think in systems, identify real business problems, and build practical AI automation solutions. Nate’s frameworks inspired me to develop my own AI Operating System and turn scattered knowledge into structured, actionable workflows. The training is practical, and the community generously shares real builds, lessons, and honest feedback. Highly recommended for serious AI builders.

reviews.body: AIS+ is a reasonably priced, well-supported step up from a genuinely strong free community. It's a good fit if you're a beginner to intermediate builder who wants structure, live coaching, and accountability around building/monetizing AI agents. Members are great and supportive which is also the case with people runing the community on a daily basis. Hope we will have more content in the classroom section, especialy on concrete portfolio pieces that are more advanced.

metadata.bio: Enterprise software leader turned AI enthusiast, always chasing what's next. Mapping 20+ years of experience onto AI's new frontier.

reviews.body: My experience has been 5 Star! Ones ability to actually go zero to hero is two-fold at AIS+. First there's the structure, lessons, tutorials and videos that provide the know how. Second Nate's team along with the amazing community provides invaluable support that pretty guarantees you'll get the mentorship, guidance and answer to any issue, roadblock or system errors you're dealing with. Just share your problem or issue and the solutions and feedback comes to you!!!

reviews.body: This is without doubt the place to be if you are serious about AI & Automation, no matter your technical knowledge. The change before/after is just insane. Joining AIS+ has genuinely changed how I operate and I think, both technically and on the business side. Highly recommended! See you inside.
